quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the center of a two-lane, two-directional highway and overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction, unless such left side is clearly visible and is free of oncoming traffic for a sufficient distance ahead to permit such overtaking and passing to be completely made without interfering with the safe operation of any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction or any vehicle overtaken.

activation.description: Driver uses left side of center on a two-lane, two-directional highway to overtake a same-direction vehicle

obligation.description: Do not make the left-of-center pass unless the statutory visibility, clear distance and noninterference conditions hold

timing.description: Measure the full original pass, approaching vehicle and overtaken vehicle timelines

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original hill-crest sightline and driver-reference pixels require independent review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: sufficient distance ahead to permit such overtaking and passing to be completely made without interfering with the safe operation of any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction or any vehicle overtaken
judgment_calls_needed.note: Preserve actual pass completion and separate approaching and overtaken vehicle responses; no numeric legal cutoff is inferred.

parameter_refs.name: requested_oncoming_distance_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 70, 120 and 170 m requested physical samples; no legal threshold

parameter_refs.name: actual_entry_oncoming_body_gap_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-measured m at original left-of-center entry
